wearFormula: max(1,sum(itemAbsenceProtection)); Ordinal is manuscript-only and never protects wear
realmAggregation: Same-type contributions use RSS within one item. Normal attack sums fixed HP sources. Deep attack multiplies separate innate/book-Ordinal/book-Power/tool-Power factors. Both defenses multiply the separately computed armor and manuscript factors; native armor/toughness is a preceding damage stage.

provisionalChoices.efficiencyStacking: highest manuscript grade; max with applicable native Efficiency; add e^2+1; no Ordinal mining multiplier
provisionalChoices.aquaAffinity: Laver helmet Lv1+ removes underwater mining penalty
provisionalChoices.depthStrider: Laver boots Lv1/2/3 are native Depth Strider I/II/III equivalents
provisionalChoices.flightOwner: Boundary manuscript inherits the jump/fall/flight package
provisionalChoices.armorWearAttenuation: pre-hit native integer wear budget divided by custom protection factor, then multiplied by consumption probability; retain fractions as expectation
